description_short: ATLUS revives the supernatural detective action RPG with modern visuals, full voice acting, quality-of-life upgrades and a heavily revised battle system.
description_ar: إعادة إتقان موسعة للعبة Devil Summoner: Raidou Kuzunoha vs. The Soulless Army. يلعب رايدو دور محقق ومتخصص في استدعاء الشياطين، ويتتبع قضية اختطاف تتحول إلى مؤامرة واسعة داخل العاصمة والعالم المظلم.
nintendoPlayModes: TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode
switch2Features: Full English and Japanese voice acting
tagline: Undertake the case of the century in a supernatural Taisho-era mystery.

gameplayPillars.title: Devil Summoner Combat
gameplayPillars.description: Fight in real time using sword, gun, defensive actions and summoned demon allies.

gameplayPillars.title: Detective Investigation
gameplayPillars.description: Question witnesses, inspect scenes and use demon Investigation Skills to solve supernatural cases.

gameplayPillars.title: Demon Collection
gameplayPillars.description: Recruit, fuse and develop more than 120 demons to build specialized combat and investigation teams.

gameplayPillars.title: Taisho Capital Exploration
gameplayPillars.description: Move between a stylized 1930s-inspired Capital and the dangerous Dark Realm.

worldSummary: A stylized alternate Taisho-era Capital inspired by 1930s Tokyo is connected to the Dark Realm, a dangerous supernatural layer inhabited by demons. Raidou moves between investigation and combat as the case expands from a disappearance into a national conspiracy.

storyChapters.title: A Strange Request
storyChapters.body: A young heiress visits the Narumi Detective Agency with a shocking request before being kidnapped.

storyChapters.title: The Dark Realm
storyChapters.body: Raidou investigates the Capital and a demon-filled parallel realm while tracking the missing girl.

storyChapters.title: A National Conspiracy
storyChapters.body: The case expands far beyond a disappearance and threatens the future of the entire nation.

faq.q: Is RAIDOU Remastered the same game on Switch and Switch 2?
faq.a: The content is fundamentally the same remaster, but Switch 2 has its own version and substantially stronger performance targets.

faq.q: What is the Switch 2 performance target?
faq.a: ATLUS lists 1920x1080 and 60 FPS targets in both handheld and TV modes.

faq.q: Does it have English voice acting?
faq.a: Yes. The remaster includes newly added Japanese and English voiceover.
Crowdsourced completion data places the main story around 19 hours, around 27 hours with extras and roughly 38 hours for completionist play.
Yes. A demo lets players progress to the start of Episode 2 and transfer save data to the full game.
Yes. The Digital Deluxe content includes training, demon, skill-book and survival packs.

verdictSummary: A polished modernization of a cult ATLUS action RPG, with the Switch 2 version standing out for its official 1080p/60 FPS target.
verdictCons: Switch and Switch 2 versions use separate software/save paths

reviews.quote: Generally favorable response to the remaster's modernization and distinctive setting.
Critics broadly praised the improved combat and preservation of the original's unusual detective-RPG identity.
Player-facing aggregate data lists an 8.1 user score.
